title: IPv6-in-IPv6 tunnel conformance: no egress decapsulation, inner-dst verify, inner hop-limit decrement
description: Spec 05-routing.md §8.9 (R-05-063, R-05-066): root MUST use IPv6-in-IPv6 per RFC 6554 whenever source-routing a packet it did not originate; E decapsulates and verifies the inner destination matches its authorized primary 02xx; root MUST decrement inner Hop Limit by initial Segments Left. Evidence: root-side encapsulation exists (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1623-1694 mesh_to_mesh, outer+RH3 at :1660-1685) but (1) no runtime implements egress decapsulation — Rust extension survey rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/util.rs:259-394 survey_routing_headers has no next-header-41 case and errors InvalidSourceRoute; C lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c has no IPv6-in-IPv6 handling; IPPROTO_IPIP missing from lichen-core next_header consts; (2) inner-dst verification not implemented in any runtime; (3) gateway.rs:1660-1685 builds outer with Hop Limit 64 and leaves inner Hop Limit untouched (no decrement by initial Segments Left). Vectors srh_root_insertion.json / srh_admission.json / source_route_hop_limit.json cover RH3 insertion/admission only. Suggested placement: gateway encapsulation path + node/gateway decapsulation + survey_routing_headers.
